title: A session message with a placeholder or a future time is refused before it is sent
why: Triage 11 sent messages stamped ahead of the clock twice on Nov 17 and 18.
note: Own mistake, 09:15 CST Nov 18. Guard: refuse a send_message whose body holds a bracketed stamp later than now-central, or text like HH:MM. Next: a lane brief with a test-author first (two cases: a future stamp and a placeholder both refuse); mover: whoever takes the lane after the coordinator's say-so.
